description: Department of Co-oparative Development Central Province - Cancellation of Liquidatory
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the cancellation of liquidation for various cooperative societies (including school cooperatives, thrift and credit societies, and producer cooperatives) under provincial cooperative statutes. This falls under business/commercial matters as it deals with the administrative status of registered commercial entities (cooperative societies), making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6) rather than a government personnel/structure matter.
